# Known gaps — offshore_marine
All values pending interview. Source: domain encoding sheet, sections A–K.

Per spread type:
- s_lay: stinger radius, roller positions, departure angle, overbend/sagbend/touchdown allowables,
  tension band, residual tension, tensioner capacity — Q B.1–B.8
- j_lay: tower angle, sagbend/touchdown allowables, tension band, tensioner capacity — Q C.1–C.4
- reel_lay: MBR (pipe and cable), spooling strain, straightener setting, residual curvature,
  end-fitting fatigue basis, tension bands — Q D.1–D.6
- heavy_lift: crane SWL by configuration, DAF, skew load factor, rigging SWL,
  max sea state per lift class — Q E.1–E.4

Cross-cutting:
- DP capability plots, footprint rings, drive-off / drift-off times — Q F.2–F.3
- Weather criteria (Hs, Tp, direction combined) per operation — Q F.1, G.1
- Forecast alpha factor and trusted horizon — Q G.2
- Cost figures (day rates, spread multipliers) — Q §1
- Incident shapes — Q J.6–J.17
